shortDescription: Create and modify issues in a JIRA instance

options.name: account_id
options.description: Sets the account identifier for the assignee when O(operation) is V(create), V(transition), or V(edit). Note that JIRA may not allow changing field values on specific transitions or states.

options.name: assignee
options.description: Sets the assignee when O(operation) is V(create), V(transition), or V(edit). Jira Cloud requires account IDs for all user-type fields. When O(cloud=true), a string value containing C(@) is resolved as an email to an account ID automatically. A string without C(@) is assumed to be an account ID. See also O(account_id) for a dedicated assignee account ID parameter. Added in community.general 12.6.0. Jira Server and Jira Data Center may still accept O(assignee) as a username. Note that JIRA may not

options.name: attachment
options.description: Information about the attachment being uploaded.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Client certificate if required. In addition to O(username) and O(password) or O(token). Not mutually exclusive.

options.name: client_key
options.description: Client certificate key if required. In addition to O(username) and O(password) or O(token). Not mutually exclusive.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Enable when using Jira Cloud. When set to V(true), the module uses Jira Cloud compatible behavior. When set to V(false) (the default), the module uses Jira Server / Data Center compatible behavior. In the future, this option might affect additional operations for Jira Cloud compatibility.

options.name: comment
options.description: The comment text to add. Note that JIRA may not allow changing field values on specific transitions or states.

options.name: comment_visibility
options.description: Used to specify comment comment visibility. See U(https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v2/api-group-issue-comments/#api-rest-api-2-issue-issueidorkey-comment-post) for details.

options.name: custom_user_fields
options.description: A list of field names (for example V(customfield_10050)) that hold user values. When O(cloud=true) and a listed field is present in O(fields) as a string containing C(@), the module resolves the email to a Jira Cloud account ID automatically. The built-in user fields O(assignee) and V(reporter) are always resolved when present; list here any further user-typed fields (from other Jira products or extensions) that should receive the same resolution.

options.name: description
options.description: The issue description, where appropriate. Note that JIRA may not allow changing field values on specific transitions or states.

options.name: fields
options.description: This is a free-form data structure that can contain arbitrary data. This is passed directly to the JIRA REST API (possibly after merging with other required data, as when passed to create). See examples for more information, and the JIRA REST API for the structure required for various fields. When O(cloud=true), user-type fields (V(assignee), V(reporter), and any fields listed in O(custom_user_fields)) that contain a string value with C(@) are automatically resolved from email to account ID. options.name: inwardissue
options.description: Set issue from which link is created.

options.name: issue
options.description: An existing issue key to operate on.

options.name: issuetype
options.description: The issue type, for issue creation.

options.name: jql
options.description: Query JIRA in JQL Syntax, for example V("CMDB Hostname" = test.example.com).

options.name: linktype
options.description: Set type of link, when action 'link' selected.

options.name: maxresults
options.description: Limit the result of O(operation=search). If no value is specified, the default JIRA limit is used. Used when O(operation=search) only, ignored otherwise.

options.name: operation
options.description: The operation to perform. V(worklog) was added in community.general 6.5.0.

options.name: outwardissue
options.description: Set issue to which link is created.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to log-in with. Must be used with O(username). Mutually exclusive with O(token).

options.name: project
options.description: The project for this operation. Required for issue creation.

options.name: status
options.description: Only used when O(operation) is V(transition), and a bit of a misnomer, it actually refers to the transition name. This is mutually exclusive with O(status_id).

options.name: status_id
options.description: Only used when O(operation) is V(transition), and refers to the transition ID. This is mutually exclusive with O(status).

options.name: summary
options.description: The issue summary, where appropriate. Note that JIRA may not allow changing field values on specific transitions or states.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Set timeout, in seconds, on requests to JIRA API.

options.name: token
options.description: The personal access token to log-in with. Mutually exclusive with O(username) and O(password).

options.name: uri
options.description: Base URI for the JIRA instance.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to log-in with. Must be used with O(password). Mutually exclusive with O(token).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Require valid SSL certificates (set to V(false) if you would like to use self-signed certificates).
